text:
sre_alex: quick async standup — TL;DR: canary passed but a couple of alert flaps overnight.

sre_alex: What I did: rolled KV-cache padding change to canary (v42), ran a lightweight synthetic through 3 regions, observed reduced 95p latency on small embeds.

sre_alex: Blockers: noticing a burst of duplicate alerting for downstream 504s during autoscale bursts — noise that hides real SLO regressions.

ops_liz: saw the dupe alerts too, added a debounce rule to the pager channel at 30s. not ideal long term tho. :zipper_mouth_face:

m_huang: FYI the 504s look correlated with a short spike of queue-depth on batcher-3. logs show swift retries hitting the fallback path. snippet:
```
batcher-3 WARN 2026-03-18T03:12:04Z retry path triggered for req 0x9f4a
storage: connection reset by peer
```

jordan: @sre_alex can you post canary metrics? curious about request distribution across zones.

sre_alex: posted canary dashboard link in #ops-dash (private). summary: 95p gen latency dropped from 240ms -> 190ms, tokens/sec improved ~12%, KV hit rate steady at 87%. no obvious region skew.

infra-sam: re: duplicates — I think three things: (1) alert dedupe window (30s) helps immediate noise, (2) long-term: split alerts by root-cause tag (queue vs auth vs storage), (3) introduce a compact composite alert that opens when >3 downstream alerts are active.

ops_liz: +1 to tagging. current runbook asks oncall to triage each 504; that makes fatigue worse. we should route to a consolidated incident channel first.

m_huang: oncall follow-ups: @oncall-bot flagged a flapping run for user-facing embed generation at 02:58 which was auto-acked and closed by deploy-bot (rolled back canary). can we make the bot attach the last 5 logs to the ticket? that would speed triage.

deploy-bot: CI: canary v42 deployed -> health-checks pass. rollback at 02:59 was manual by jordan. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

jordan: rolled back because our synthetic hit a regression in long-context memory usage on gpu-x. I reverted the micro-change to kv eviction padding while we debug.

sre_alex: action items: (A) infra-sam to propose dedupe + composite alert by EOD; (B) m_huang to add last-5-logs attachment to oncall-bot flow; (C) I will re-run canary with eviction padding at 10% less aggressive and observe for 6h.

infra-sam: starting a short RFC in #eng-infra — will ping here when ready.

m_huang: I'll wire the log attach in the morning; adding test for size and PII scrub.

ops_liz: status: no open pager now. oncall shift can keep an eye; if we get >2 composite alerts in 15m we escalate to SRE lead.

sre_alex: blockers resolved for now, continuing canary run. leaving notes in the canary doc. thanks all — post here any quick pings or if you see new flaps. :coffee:
